CHIKKABALLAPURA FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 363 R/W 366A,
376(2)(n), 506 R/W 34 OF IPC AND SEC.6 OF POCSO ACT.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo seeking to withdraw the petition.

2. The memo reads as under:
"The undersigned humbly prays this Hon'ble Court be pleased to permit him to withdraw the above petition with liberty to file bail application before the Additional District and Sessions Judge, FTSC-I, Chikkaballapura after the evidence of the victim,
in the interest of justice and equity."
3. In view of the memo, petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
